messages.author: 09d9fcb029dfd640
messages.subject: problem with exporting images
parts:
Hi

I have some problems when I want to save an image to eps.

The following is written:

> ggsave("proba.eps", width=11.7, height=8.3)
Warning messages:
1: Removed 2 rows containing missing values (stat_smooth).
2: Removed 2 rows containing missing values (geom_point).
3: In grid.Call.graphics("L_polygon", x$x, x$y, index) :
semi-transparency is not supported on this device: reported only
once per page

I am interested only in the warning 3.

Does anyone have an idea?

Regards

Jure

--

messages.subject: Re: [Rkoholiki] Re: problem with exporting images
parts:
Bah, mea culpa. Bi upal napisat malo dummy kode, da še jaz tole probam? Izgleda, da ima eps() probleme z ohranjanjem prosojnosti http://stackoverflow.com/questions/4001316/how-do-i-preserve-transparency-in-ggplot2. Če delaš s pdf() boš moral nastaviti pravi encoding, da boš ohranil šumnike. Glej http://stackoverflow.com/questions/3434349/sweave-not-printing-localized-characters


lp,
Roman
